title: Learning When to Stop: Adaptive Latent Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

rs.key_step: latent recurrent模型增加binary停止头，SFT教可变思考长度，再按组正确率切换长度奖惩做RL。
rs.why_non_obvious: 停止成为模型动作；对正确子集中心化仍无法理论保证准确率不降。
rs.trigger_condition: When fixed latent depth wastes computation, learn a stop decision and condition length incentives on sampled group difficulty.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When fixed latent depth wastes computation, learn a stop decision and condition length incentives on sampled group difficulty.

signatures.operation: SFT长度c*k+b裁剪；GRPO用easy组奖短、hard组奖长
signatures.failure_boundary: 仅Llama3.2-1B/GSM8K-Aug；另variant精度下降，不能推广无损；latent模型仍低于CoT57.09%。

relevance.how: 可训练stop head但latentsteps不等于工具调用。
全正确组长度奖励共同系数在std下可消失。
correct-only length shaping的无损主张有直接反例。
